tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page background. The deepest layer; every glow is read against it.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: App chrome: top bar, sidebar rail.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, capsules, the composer, session rows.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Nested fills inside a surface: chips, step icons, avatar grounds, hover rows.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: User message bubble; the strongest neutral fill.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline on surface-100 cards, dividers, step list rule.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Hairline on hover.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Hairline when a card is open or selected (pair with shadow-raised).

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (13.9:1 on bg-000).

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Narration / said-step prose, the said dot. On any surface.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Muted: captions, meta, chip text, current-step mono line. 5.6:1 on surface-100, 6.3:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Dim: timestamps, placeholders, inactive trail dots. 3.3:1 on bg-000 — decorative or large text only, never body copy.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent, agent-hue and status fills (7.3:1 on accent).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: primary buttons, focus ring, live avatar ring, bash dot, slider fill. 7.3:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: Links at rest, hover state of accent text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Link hover, the 1px core of a max-effort glow, selection highlight.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: 18% accent wash behind an active row or selected node.

tokens.name: kind-bash
tokens.usage: Step kind: shell / tool run. Trail dots, step icons, chips.

tokens.name: kind-read
tokens.usage: Step kind: file read / fetch.

tokens.name: kind-edit
tokens.usage: Step kind: file edit / write.

tokens.name: kind-ask
tokens.usage: Step kind: asked the user, waiting on input.

tokens.name: kind-subagent
tokens.usage: Step kind: spawned a subagent or handed off to a teammate.

tokens.name: kind-think
tokens.usage: Step kind: thinking / planning.

tokens.name: kind-said
tokens.usage: Step kind: intermediate narration. Its dot is a 2px-radius square, not a circle.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success: done badge, idle breathing dot, drawn check. 10.2:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Success chip fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention: needs input, near a limit. Context meter 70–90%.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Attention chip fill, attention card wash.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Error: red dot, error chip, failed step, context meter over 90%. 6.9:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: err-tint
tokens.usage: Error chip and step-icon fill (14%).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Yolo mode on-state: the toggle track and its glow. Same hue as err on purpose — it is a risk state.

tokens.name: agent-1
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 1 (periwinkle). Avatars, node strokes, lane rails. Assign by stable hash of agent id.

tokens.name: agent-2
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 2 (violet).

tokens.name: agent-3
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 3 (cyan).

tokens.name: agent-4
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 4 (mint).

tokens.name: agent-5
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 5 (amber).

tokens.name: agent-6
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 6 (pink).

tokens.name: agent-7
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 7 (teal).

tokens.name: agent-8
tokens.usage: Per-agent identity hue 8 (lavender). Beyond 8 agents, cycle and add the glyph to disambiguate.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: 45% accent. Live capsule border (mixed with line-100), busy-sweep core, pulse rings.

tokens.name: glow-ok
tokens.usage: 35% ok. Idle breathing halo.

tokens.name: glow-warn
tokens.usage: 35% warn. Attention card halo.

tokens.name: glow-err
tokens.usage: 35% err. Error dot ring, Yolo-on halo.

tokens.name: glow-subagent
tokens.usage: 40% violet. Outer bloom of the max-effort glow; team-view edge pulses.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Team graph: resting edge between two agents.

tokens.name: edge-active
tokens.usage: Team graph: an edge carrying a message right now (animated dash).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Board and page titles. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings in editors (agent, skill, connector).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card / capsule / session titles and strong labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Collapsed by default, including the turn in progress.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Step labels, form field labels, tab labels, buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary meta under titles. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, command detail lines, MCP endpoints.

styles.name: meta-mono
styles.usage: Current-step shimmer line, branch pills, tool ids.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Elapsed timers and token counts. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The figure inside a radial meter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot gaps in a trail, icon-to-text in chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inner padding of pills, capsule row vertical pad.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Capsule row horizontal pad, composer pad, avatar-to-title gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters at phone width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside an editor.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side padding, header pad.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Board padding, gap between message groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of a board, empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The said-step square dot.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code pills, the tight corner of a speech bubble.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, step rows, inputs, step icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, capsules, the composer, session rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Message bubbles (pair with radius-sm on the tail corner).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, toggle tracks.

shadow.note: Glow is the system's elevation. Resting surfaces are flat; a surface earns a glow only when it is live, open, focused or dangerous.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: An open capsule or a hovered session card. Dark drop only — no colour.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on any control: a gap ring so it reads on every surface.

tokens.name: glow-live
tokens.usage: A card whose agent is working right now; the composer while sending.

tokens.name: glow-done
tokens.usage: Brief (600ms) flash when a turn or run completes, then fades to flat.

tokens.name: glow-attention
tokens.usage: A session or node waiting on the user. Pulses 2.4s.

tokens.name: glow-danger
tokens.usage: Yolo mode on; a failed node in the team graph.

tokens.name: glow-max
tokens.usage: Effort slider at maximum: the one two-colour bloom in the system. Reserve it.
